test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**but**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• But is used as a conjunction in the given sentence to link two ideas
 
• The use of conjunction needs to be in agreement with the two clauses.

So the complete passage is:- *The pandemic in India occurred at a time (1) when the crop was standing all ready to be (2) harvested. If NAFED had not intervened with the initiative (3) to purchase the stocks of farmers in these circumstances, it (4) would not only have been devastating for the farmers (5) but also led to a food emergency later on.*
